method: Review every final-public Top 3 candidate for the fixed 20 head + 100 uniform sampled corpus keys. This is a finite editorial audit, not correctness ground truth or a live-menu test.

known_editorial_concerns.issue: single-character plural suffix remains as a standalone completion
colloquial abbreviated greeting remains split into single-character completion
low-value continuation generally needs more text to complete the expression

limits: Samples differ from v1 after filtering, so do not compare their concern fractions as a measured whole-library improvement. Dictionary POS is imperfect; copied text and ordinary weak-context completions can remain. No post-evaluation rule or threshold changes.
